senses.gloss: m. ch. (v. חָכַךְ I) gold hooks over the female bosom (h. כּוּמָז).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 35:22">Targ. O. Ex. XXXV, 22</cite> (ed. Amst. <cite ref="M00826"><he>מָחוּךְ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Numbers 31:50">Num. XXXI, 50</cite>.—

Sabb. 64ᵃ היינו דמתרגמינן מ׳ that is the reason why the Biblical כומז is rendered in the Targum with maḥokh (obscenity, v. preced.), v. גִּיחוּךְ.—Pl. מְחוֹכִין, מְחוֹכַיָּא. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.; Targ. Y. I Num. l. c. (not מהוכיא; Y. II מָעוֹכַיָּא).
